title: RAF inhibitors prime wild-type RAF to activate the MAPK pathway and enhance growth
central_claims: ATP-competitive RAF inhibitors suppress BRAF(V600E) signaling but activate RAS-dependent RAF dimerization, MAPK signaling and sometimes tumor growth in other genetic contexts.
